quality.method: Signed corner scaled Jacobian relative to polygon area normal; 3D included corner angles; max/min edge ratio; adjacent polygon area ratio; unique-edge length CV; graph valence; actual count error. Separate from manifold/surface validation.

alignment.loopContinuity: Nearest-edge selection graph only; not a global topological guarantee or certified curve correspondence.

guidePaths.sampleMethod: 257 samples uniformly spaced by authored polyline arc length; measured against this connected output-edge path.

guideAlignment.loopContinuity: Nearest-edge selection graph only; not a global topological guarantee or certified curve correspondence.

guideSampleMethod: 257 uniformly spaced authored arc-length samples per guide, measured against its connected output-edge path.
limits: Measured surface/topology checks are bounded; they do not certify absence of every3D self intersection or exact native equivalence.

surfaceValidation.scope: Exact nearest-triangle distances at deterministic bounded samples, not a Hausdorff certificate or a complete self-intersection test.
